jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, who will like to join our Tech team in Copenhagen!

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to join our Tech team in Copenhagen. Someone who's excited about where software development is heading and wants to help shape how we build with AI.

As a member of our Tech team, you'll be an essential part of developing digital products together with our clients and the team around you. Since we're an agency, we work with a wide range of clients, typically in focused sprints where we build new products or improve products we've built with them before. Our stack is TypeScript with Next.js and React at its core, extending into backend services, APIs and integrations as projects demand.

We're operating in a time of agentic engineering. AI agents are changing how software gets built, and we embrace that: we use agentic tools to ship faster and build AI-powered features into client products. At the same time, we know that reaching the quality we aim for means sticking to the fundamentals of good software development. Agents amplify good engineering, they don't replace it. We're looking for someone with strong fundamentals in architecture, code quality and judgment, who can put these new tools to work without compromising on craft.

We have an excellent team across our Copenhagen, Montreal, London and Toronto offices. We'll throw challenges at you, teach you new things, learn from you, and make sure we grow together toward our ambition of setting new and higher standards for the web.

Check out some of our work HERE.

Key tasks

• 
Shape, build and improve digital products end to end, from frontend (Next.js/React) to backend services, APIs and integrations

• 
Inspire adoption of agentic engineering: use AI coding agents in daily work and share learnings and insights with a team that explores and grows together

• 
Build AI-powered features and agentic systems into client products, such as MCP/LLM integrations, automations and intelligent product experiences

• 
Take technical ownership on client projects: architecture decisions, technical direction, and quality

• 
Lead by example on good development practices and ways of working, across both technical and non-technical team members

• 
Stay ahead of new trends and bring them into the team so we keep delivering top services to our clients

• 
Support with tech knowledge and skills across Signifly's different teams

What we expect of you

• 
Solid experience as a full-stack developer in a similar senior position, and strong with modern TypeScript, Next.js/React and backend development (Node.js, APIs, databases)

• 
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development (tools like Claude Code or similar) and real curiosity about pushing this frontier

• 
Experience building AI-native APIs and product features is a big plus

• 
You're good at understanding real-world client problems and proposing smart technical solutions to address them

• 
You thrive in helping others, whether it's a client, a project manager, a developer colleague or the sales team

• 
You take ownership: of your code, your projects, and the growth of the people around you

Please expect no less from us

The most important thing that we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team. We have an informal organization with minimal hierarchy, where there is plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, as well as taking part in shaping our team, culture, and product offering.

**

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:**

• 
Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focuses (paid)

• 
Fresh catered lunch of mostly organic produce and with vegetarian options

• 
Coffee, tea, soft drinks, snacks, etc. - and wine, beer and drinks on Fridays

• 
Beautiful office space with emphasis on noise reduction, centrally located in Vesterbro

• 
Paid equipment of high quality - you choose what you prefer

• 
In-office massage service

• 
Inspiration-trips to events, meet-ups, and conferences

• 
Company paid pension and health insurance

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance

• 
Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

• 
Opportunity to work-exchange with our office in Montreal, London and Toronto

And if you think something is missing, just let us know. We can probably work together to add it. After all, we are trying to create the best possible place to work!

About Signifly

Signifly is one of the fastest growing agencies in Denmark, and our young and energetic team has won several awards for our innovative approach to digital products and user experiences. We are a young and ambitious team that are constantly pushing the limits for our work and our own capabilities.

At Signifly, we collaborate with a broad range of clients from all industries, to create new and innovative digital products and business models. We are a team of developers, designers, film makers and digital strategists, and we believe that creativity, entrepreneurship and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the innovation and change that will help shape a better tomorrow.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer passionate about building innovative digital products

(We’re also open for an ambitious mid-level)

On-site position in CPH. No remote or hybrid.

Signifly is a digital agency with digital products and experiences at heart. We’ve helped shape many of the digital products and experiences used by Danes every day. From apps and e-commerce to websites and digital services.

As a Product Designer in Copenhagen, you’ll work alongside designers and developers to create best-in-class digital experiences for ambitious start-ups and established enterprises.

At Signifly, we are a team so besides working with the rest of the design team, you will also be working with Consultants and strategists to understand the strategic and business objectives as they relate to the product experience.

What you’ll be working on

• 
Widely used products. Define and design digital products and experiences used by a large audience across Denmark.

• 
Complex digital products. Design best-in-class apps, interfaces, services, websites, tools etc. for varied industries such as B2B, fintech, medtech, government, start-ups etc.

• 
Understand complex, Deliver simple: Turn complex workflows, systems, and requirements into intuitive and effortless user experiences.

• 
Strategic execution. Understand user journeys, ideate during discovery, and deliver final designs with a strong UX foundation.

• 
Deliver from start to finish. Own the quality and delivery of all phases from early research phase to final high fidelity UI delivery.

• 
Design for real users. Plan and participate in research, synthesize insights, and turn user needs and behaviours into meaningful product decisions.

• 
Help shape how we build with AI. We expect you to be actively exploring the frontier of design and AI and possible tools. Use AI in your work and help explore and define how AI can improve how we research, design, prototype, and ship products.

• 
Create best-in-class UI. Craft polished and intuitive interfaces that balance usability, visual quality, accessibility and business goals.

• 
Take ownership. Take responsibility for the quality of the customer journey, actively seek feedback, and know when and how to bring others into the process.

Job requirements

What we expect from you

• 
Complex digital products. Experience designing SaaS, B2B, enterprise, data-heavy, or workflow-driven products where simplicity is key.

• 
Startup environments. Experience navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, taking ownership, and balancing creative ambition with the realities of delivery.

• 
AI-enabled products. Experience designing AI-powered experiences or working confidently with emerging AI interaction patterns and workflows.

• 
Design systems. Experience building, evolving, or contributing to scalable component libraries, tokens, patterns, and documentation.

• 
Rapid prototyping. Confident using tools such as Figma, Framer, code, or AI prototyping tools to quickly turn ideas into realistic, testable experiences.

• 
Flexible and multidisciplinary. Experience working across different industries like e-commerce, fintech, healthcare, SaaS, lifestyle, mobility etc.. And across changing platforms like native apps, services, platforms, kiosks etc.

• 
Cross-functional facilitation. Experience running workshops, presenting design rationale, navigating stakeholder feedback, and creating alignment across Product, Engineering, and business teams.

Please expect from us

The most important thing that we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team. We have an informal organization with minimal hierarchy, where there is plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, as well as taking part in shaping our team, culture, and product offering.

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:

• 
Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focuses (paid)

• 
Fresh catered lunch of mostly organic produce and with vegetarian options

• 
Coffee, tea, soft drinks, snacks, etc. day and night

• 
Beautiful office space with emphasis noise reduction, centrally located in Vesterbro

• 
Paid equipment of high quality - you choose what you prefer

• 
In-office massage service

• 
Voluntary sports activities including Company Soccer & E-Sports league.

• 
Inspiration-trips to events, meet-ups, and conferences

• 
Company paid pension and health insurance

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance

• 
Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

• 
Opportunity to work-exchange with our office in Montreal or London

About Signifly

At Signifly, we collaborate with a broad range of clients from all industries, to create new and innovative digital products and business models. We are a team of developers, designers, film makers and digital strategists, and we believe that creativity, entrepreneurship and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the innovation and change that will help shape a better tomorrow. For further information about the position, please contact Søren Schrøder (Head of Design) at ss@signifly.com.

Checkout our work at Signifly.com.

We are looking for a Senior Strategist (Brand/Comms)

Hi there,

We’re looking for a Senior Strategist (Brand, Comms) to help shape and strengthen the brands of tomorrow. You’ll work closely with world-class designers, creatives, developers, and consultants to turn insights into strategy and strategy into action.

Danish proficiency is a plus (but not a must) for this role.

What you’ll be doing:

• 
Research & Insights: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research (e.g., stakeholder interviews, workshops, market research, trend analysis, and data interpretation).

• 
Brand Strategy & Positioning: Develop brand platforms, incl. core narratives, positioning, and messaging frameworks that drive brand-led business.

• 
Communication & Content Strategy: Craft brand-led communication strategies, key messaging, and storytelling approaches.

• 
Strategy in Action: Move seamlessly from strategic thinking to execution by shaping campaign plans, content, messaging, and activations that create measurable impact.

• 
Business Impact: Connect brand and communication initiatives to business objectives, customer needs, and measurable outcomes.

• 
Collaboration & Execution: Work closely with designers, creatives, and strategists to ensure brand vision is executed effectively.

• 
Client & Project Leadership: Manage multiple brand and communication projects, maintain strong client relationships, and present insights and recommendations.

• 
Adept copywriting skills in both Danish and English are key - you know how to craft compelling narratives and articulate strategic thinking clearly.

We don’t expect you to tick every single box, but the more, the better - and we value potential just as much as experience.

Job requirements

What we expect from you:

• 
A strong understanding of brand-building, communication strategy, and storytelling.

• 
A track record in crafting compelling narratives and brand platforms.

• 
The ability to combine creative exploration with analytical and structured thinking, and to translate your findings into crisp recommendations and strategic guidance for clients.

• 
Leadership skills - you naturally guide projects, support junior colleagues, and help grow the brand and comms function at Signifly.

• 
A collaborative mindset - you work well across teams and communicate effectively.

• 
You’re comfortable using emerging tools and technologies, including AI, to accelerate research, sharpen thinking, and improve execution.

Your background

• 
3+ years of experience in brand strategy, communications, or marketing (agency, consultancy, or client-side).

• 
A relevant academic background - or a strong track record proving your skills.

What you can expect from us

We offer an ambitious yet down-to-earth work environment with a focus on learning, collaboration, and personal growth.

Plus, a few perks:

• 
Annual, paid team trip (Italy, Portugal, and Copenhagen in past years).

• 
Fresh catered lunch (mostly organic, vegetarian options available).

• 
Unlimited snacks & drinks (including Friday wine & beers).

• 
Beautiful office at Vesterbro Torv.

• 
High-quality equipment - you choose what you prefer.

• 
In-office massage service.

• 
Paid inspiration trips (events, meetups, conferences).

• 
Company-paid pension and health insurance.

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance.

• 
Merit-based career progression - your impact matters more than seniority.

• 
Work-exchange opportunities in Montreal, Toronto, or London.

And if something’s missing? Let us know.

**

About Signifly**

We create brands and digital experiences that delight people and drive business. We’ve been at it for over 10 years, and our awards say we’re doing a decent job. Our clients range from FMCG to SaaS, spanning startups, scale-ups, and global companies. In our Copenhagen office, we’re a team of 50+ strategists, designers, developers, PMs, and creatives - working together to push boundaries and have fun doing it.

For further information about the position, please contact Mathias Rønnow, Head of Strategy, at mr@signifly.com.

jobs.occupation: Are you our new jewellery design intern?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a jewellery design intern to support us with design and production.

longvé is a dynamic and innovative jewellery start-up located in the heart of Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv. We offer a fresh digital approach to the jewellery industry, with our digital platform empowering customers to design their own jewellery. We offer the customers classic customisable designs, handcrafted quality and sustainable sourcing of recycled materials, all at a transparent and fair price. The company launched at the end of 2022.

We are currently seeking an intern jewellery designer. This is a unique opportunity to impact a newly launched brand, and get a steep learning curve, while working in a high-paced start-up environment, where we make sure to have fun.

Besides being enrolled in a study program within jewellery design, fashion design or something similar, the ideal candidate should have:

• Experience in Rhino software

• Knowledge of rendering in Keyshot is an advantage.

• Skilled in ideation and sketching.

• Responsibility to meet deadlines and take ownership of the project.

• Ability to work independently in a high-paced start-up environment.

• Willingness to be a part of something new and exciting.

**

What you will do:**

As an intern, you will help develop new jewellery styles and collections by sketching new designs, and drawing up designs in Rhino. You will also have the opportunity to work with our partners for translating the designs into the hands of our craftsmen, as well as preparing the right quality image material for frontline sales and marketing use.

What you get:

• Hands-on experience with building a new jewellery brand

• Insights into and experience with the start-up world

• Possibility to build up portfolio material

• Autonomous working schedule where you can influence ways of working

• Working closely with the founders and joining a team that values great energy, good humour and strong collaboration

The start date and length of the internship will be agreed with the selected candidate. The internship may lead to a potential job opportunity based on the fit, skills, and growth of the business.

We promise to give you hands-on experience as well as an exciting playground for you to test, develop and execute great ideas. If you find this an exciting opportunity, please send your CV and resume, with some examples you have done, and the style you like personally. Send to Katja Schjølin at katja@longve.com.

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer | North Aquaculture · Grindsted, Denmark
jobs.description:
We aim to strengthen our Engineering Department and are therefore seeking a Project Engineer. You will receive training in RAS (Recirculating Aquaculture System) design and engineering, including pressure loss calculations, pipe system dimensioning, quality control of mechanical equipment such as pumps and heaters/chillers, sizing of water treatment facilities, creation and coordination of drawings, P&ID’s, and other technical project documents.

As a Project Engineer, we are looking for a systematic, detail-oriented, and self-motivated individual who enjoys working on problem-solving. You will receive training and guidance, but we expect you to take initiative and take ownership of your daily tasks.

Main responsibilities:

• Create and maintain design & engineering deliverables throughout the project life cycle.

• Coordinate and evaluate technical documentation and system descriptions.

• Collaborate with our design, project and sales team

• Consult with customer, project group and subcontractors.

• Dimensioning and calculation of water treatment system, piping systems and RAS-equipment.

• The role will involve some traveling to our clients and RAS facilities.

Qualifications and experience:

• Ideally, a Bachelor’s degree or Technical education in mechanical, hydraulic or process engineering.

• Preferably 1-3 years of relevant work experience.

• You thrive working as part of a team but can also work independently.

• You are analytical and have problem-solving skills

• Fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Experience from the landbased aquaculture industry is an advantage.

If you find this role interesting and have any questions, please feel free to contact Peter Schytt by phone [+45 21 80 77 82](

jobs.occupation: Experienced IT Developer, Salesforce - Gdańsk or Viby
jobs.description:
Ready to boost your Salesforce development career and take it to the next level? Do not miss this opportunity to co-create a digital ecosystem built around our Commercial Salesforce platform. Whether you are passionate about Service or Sales, we have got exciting projects lined up for you.

How you will make an impact

As an Experienced Salesforce Developer, we want you to build features and applications for our Customer Service Agents and support incidents across the Commercial Salesforce area. Your work will contribute to Arla’s Salesforce agenda while delivering strong capabilities for our partners in Customer Service. This role reports to the Head of IT Product, Customers within Commercial IT & Digital, and you will collaborate closely with other developers, architects, consultants and other team members to achieve our long-term goals. Further, the responsibilities will involve:

• Designing, building and driving implementation of new features and functionalities

• Coordinating work and mentoring other members of the team

• Troubleshooting and prioritizing incidents related to Salesforce applications and integrations

• Collaboration with developers in solving the root causes of issues and getting them fixed

• Defining, securing and monitoring of the system

• Document processes and improving ways of working

What will make you successful?

To address our rich Salesforce agenda designed for upcoming years, we look for an in-depth knowledge of the platform to grow an internal team of Salesforce-oriented experts. We look for a desire to understand and improve customer service-related processes, along with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to less technical stakeholders. To excel in this role, we imagine you possess the following qualifications:

• Proficiency in Salesforce development tools, including Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning components

• Clear insight of Salesforce best practices, coding, and design guidelines, as well as key Salesforce architectural concepts

• Expertise in integrating Salesforce with other systems using APIs and middleware (integrations with SAP ERP are beneficial)

• Solid experience with complex Salesforce customization and configuration

• Advanced design and implementation skills; strong grasp of architectural patterns and integration design.

• Experience with Agentforce and Data360 is an advantage

• Experience working in agile methodology

What do we offer?

At Arla, you'll join a market-leading company behind nutritious household-favourite brands, committed to making a positive impact for our customers, the farmer owners behind our cooperative, and the wider world. We are passionate about developing our people and promoting from within, fostering a positive and collaborative culture where individuals can thrive and reach their full potential. With Arla’s strong commitment to building a Salesforce-driven organization, we offer both employment stability and the opportunity to be part of an ambitious and evolving Salesforce agenda for years to come, creating exciting opportunities for professional growth and long-term career development.

Would you like to join us?

If you are enthusiastic about Salesforce technology, want to drive business success and have the skills and experience, we are looking for, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join Arla and be part of a team that values innovation and excellence.

For additional information, please contact Head of IT Product, Annemette Eskildsen Krusell at anesk@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

BALTHAZAR CHAMPAGNE BAR IS LOOKING FOR A BARTENDER

Are you passionate about champagne & cocktails? Do you have the drive to develop and nurture working relationships, both with our guests and within your workplace? Then we can´t wait to hear from you! We are looking for a sparkling on-call Bartender to join our motivated team in the best Champagne bar!

WE OFFER

An exciting working day in an international environment in Copenhagen unique Champagne Bar. We are a young and dynamic team, who together delivers a personal, stylish and elegant service of the highest international standard.

ABOUT THE JOB

As part of the Bartenders team at Balthazar, you will take part in creating new exciting cocktails for our always-evolving drinks menu. Along with your colleagues, you will maintain high guest loyalty throughout high guest satisfaction and ensure that all guests receive a unique and magical experience. And yes, we are up late at night, but isn´t it the best time to enjoy champagne?

WE EXPECT

That you have previous experience as bartender in a high end bar or restaurant. You have a wide knowledge of quality drinks & modern cocktails. You are sincerely passionate and engaged both with guests and employees. In other words with your professional skills and outgoing personality, we expect that you will be able to create unique results and experiences for our guests at any time. And of course, you love champagne! You are flexible with your working hours and you can work evenings between Wednesdays and Saturdays. The position is on an on-call basis with start as soon as possible.

Are you curious about how world-class software products are built and delivered?

At Trackman, we create innovative technology used by athletes and sports enthusiasts around the world. Behind every great product is a strong focus on quality, and we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Software Quality Assurance team and help us ensure that our web applications deliver the best possible user experience.

This is a great opportunity for a student who enjoys technology, has an eye for detail, and wants practical experience working closely with software developers, product teams, and QA professionals in a modern technology company.

The Role

As a Student Assistant in Software Quality Assurance, you will become part of a collaborative team working with the quality of our web-based products and services.

You do not need prior experience in software testing. We are primarily looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and motivated to understand how software products are developed and improved.

Your responsibilities may include:

• 
Helping validate new features and improvements across our web applications

• 
Exploring the software from a user perspective and identifying areas that can be improved

• 
Assisting with documenting findings and communicating observations to developers and product teams

• 
Supporting the maintenance of test documentation and quality-related processes

• 
Participating in team meetings and collaborating with colleagues across development and product teams

• 
Contributing to quality initiatives that help us continuously improve our products

You will gain hands-on experience with software development processes, quality assurance practices, defect reporting, and modern collaboration tools used in professional product development environments.

Job requirements

Who We Are Looking For

We imagine that you:

• 
Are currently enrolled in a higher education program

• 
Have an interest in software, technology, or digital products

• 
Enjoy learning new systems and tools

• 
Are structured and pay attention to details

• 
Like collaborating with others and communicating your observations clearly

• 
Take responsibility for your tasks and are comfortable working independently when needed

• 
Have good English communication skills, both written and spoken

Most importantly, you are curious, motivated to learn, and enjoy understanding how things work.

It Is a Plus If You Have Experience With

Don't worry if you don't tick all the boxes. These are simply nice-to-have skills that you can also learn while working with us:

• 
Basic understanding of websites, web applications, or software development

• 
Experience working with technical tools or systems

• 
Interest in software testing, quality assurance, or product quality

• 
Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar collaboration tools

What We Offer

At Trackman, you will join a team of passionate colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow professionally.

We offer:

• 
Practical experience within software quality assurance and product development

• 
Mentorship and support from experienced QA professionals

• 
Insight into how innovative software products are developed and maintained

• 
A flexible student position that works alongside your studies

• 
A modern workplace with excellent facilities at our headquarters in Hørsholm

• 
Great colleagues, social activities, and plenty of opportunities to learn and develop

The position is expected to be 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams and study commitments. The role is primarily based at our office in Hørsholm.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Technical Project Manager - Data & Migration Team
jobs.description:
As our next Technical Project Manager in the Data & Migrations team, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most

About the role

This is a Senior role designed to provide program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. As a manager within the Migration team, you will be handling projects and programs with regards to migration implementation to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth and regulatory compliance. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

You will provide program/project management oversight for all customer implementations falling under the Migrations team’s scope.

You will lead project teams consisting of data engineers/scientists. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, project management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

As a Technical Project Manager for the Migration team your responsibilities include:

jobs.occupation: Global Business Services (GBS) Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Global Business Services (GBS) Finance Transformation Manager

• Full-time

• Field of interest: Technology, Transformation & Data

• Level of hire: Experienced hire

Company Description

With more than 2,700 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About our team

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte’s consulting practice and consists of 350 dedicated consultants who work within all aspects of the CFO area and engage with clients to advise, transform, optimise, and operate the finance function. We have private and public as well as national and international clients across different industries and of different sizes, and we work with the lion’s share of C25 companies and public institutions.

Global Business Services (GBS) is an integral part of Deloitte’s Finance Transformation practice. The GBS team is dedicated to helping organizations transform their business operations, driving higher efficiency, effectiveness, and agility. By leveraging a comprehensive suite of services, the GBS practice supports clients in optimizing shared services, outsourcing, and global business service models to create value and enhance performance.

We are seeking an experienced and skilled Transformation Manager to join our GBS team. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of operating model structures and Business Process Re-engineering driven through the lens of cost optimization and efficiency augmentation, experience with the interplay of technology and process design, and change management capabilities. This role will be pivotal in driving strategic business transformation initiatives, focusing on re-enforcing cost optimization strategies by energizing core operational processes and technology design and implementation phases (ERP, process mining, automation and visualization tools).

Job Description

As a Transformation Manager, you will lead large complex engagements for some of the world's biggest organizations. You will identify, design, and implement creative business and technology solutions aimed at driving operational effectiveness, cost efficiencies and organizational agility. In this role, you will architect strategies and transformation programs that will enable process excellence and value creation by optimizing day-to-day operational finance functions using lean methodology in end-to-end process areas such as order to cash, procure to pay, close, consolidation, reporting. You will be responsible for leading business model transformations and cultivating enterprise agility to ensure transformations are anchored in, and unlock, value.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Leading Project Delivery

• Driving large scale transformations, complex and cross functional engagements

• Advising clients on process re-engineering and process optimization to support enterprise-wide decision-making, improve finance operations, and strengthen stakeholder management

• Lead the technology solution design and implementation ensuring high quality adhering to the timelines and defined budget

• Engaging in Executive- Level Interactions

• Partner with C-level executives to address strategic objectives and challenges.

• Present actionable strategies in clear, compelling terms.

• Driving Business Development

• Lead RFPs/ proposal preparation by collaborating across competencies/ alliances/ service lines.

• Cultivate and nurture client relationships beyond project delivery, exploring avenues for repeat business.

• Stakeholder Management

• Build and maintain strong connections with CXOs across various sectors.

• Project Financials

• Manage budgets and financial performance for your projects.

• Mentorship and Team Culture-

• Mentor and guide a team of consultants, fostering a positive and collaborative culture.

• Encourage professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Ideally, you have:

• Around 6-9 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, finance process excellence, GBS, Shared Services and/or BPO sector

• 4+ years of Direct people management experience

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

• Fluency in Danish is a big plus

What you bring to the team:

• Experience with process excellence, including but not limited to end-to-end process areas such as order to cash, procure to pay, close, consolidation, reporting

• Knowledge of GBS lifecycle and able to run projects in it as a Project Manager

• Experience with enabling technologies in core finance processes (e.g., Basware, HighRadius, BlackLine, etc.)

• Experience in using tools for process mining, visualization tools, Robotics Process Automation (RPA) and understanding of GenAI opportunities in driving transformation

• Strong process expertise in transforming and optimizing day-to-day operational functions (e.g. finance, HR) using lean methodology

• Experience in designing leading practice-based processes and driving the entire journey from assessment, design to implementation

• Superior critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Exceptional interpersonal, team-building and oral and written communication skills; outstanding integrity, initiative, creativity, and passion

• Experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce or other customer-oriented workflow platforms

• Baseline understanding and position on the current and future applications of Artificial Intelligence in GBS

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

The Aarhus Institute of Advanced Studies (AIAS) is pleased to announce an exclusive fellowship opportunity for a researcher who holds a position at a Swedish research institution. The fellowship is made possible through a collaboration with Riksbankens Jubileumsfond in Sweden.The purpose of the AIAS-RJ fellowship is to strengthen the ties and expand collaborations between the Swedish and Danish research communities.

Why apply for an AIAS-RJ Fellowship

AIAS is a haven for intellectual exploration, hosting excellent researchers eager to develop their work in an interdisciplinary, international and collaborative environment. AIAS nurtures an innovative atmosphere where breakthroughs emerge through transparent, inclusive and reflective discussions, offering a space for engagement and creativity.

The AIAS-RJ fellowship gives the selected fellow the opportunity to concentrate on their own research interests while also being an active member of the AIAS research community and participating in and contributing to seminars and activities beyond their own field of expertise. The fellow must be eager to engage in the interdisciplinary community at AIAS and expand research collaborations with colleagues at Aarhus University.

Who can apply for an AIAS-RJ Fellowship

The call is open to curiosity-driven researchers who:

• are of any nationality who hold a tenured position at a Swedish research institution

• work within the humanities and social sciences

• have a research experience of minimum 4 years after completion of the PhD

A unique interdisciplinary platform at AIAS

AIAS fosters connections, sparks ideas and dissolves boundaries as fellows engage with researchers from different disciplines within the Institute and across departments and research hubs at Aarhus University. Therefore, the call welcomes applications from all research areas and themes.

With a location within the unique campus of Aarhus University, AIAS functions as an interdisciplinary platform that connects researchers across Aarhus University and international scholars. AIAS has fellows who work in thematic groups or in individual fellowships, and hosts events and activities, which AIAS-RJ fellows are welcome to join and contribute to.

AIAS and Aarhus University strive to create a multidisciplinary, inclusive academic environment and to be an inspiring workplace for all by fostering a culture in which the individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The fellowship includes

The AIAS-RJ Fellow is offered:

• a salary based on seniority (employment conditions and wages are regulated through the Danish collective union agreements)

• travel costs to and from Aarhus

• relocation assistance

• a moderate budget for research-related costs

The AIAS-RJ Fellow will have office space at AIAS and can participate in academic training activities, conferences and workshops at AIAS. They will also be affiliated with the relevant research environments at Aarhus University.

How to apply: Application process and deadline

Applications must be submitted online via the system: GrantOne.

In the ‘Guide for Applicants,’ you can find the detailed application requirements and more information on the structure of the application system, the selection criteria and the selection process.

Timeline of the application process

• Opening of call: August 2026.

• Deadline for applications: 24 November 2026 at 12.00 (noon) CET.

• Evaluation and selection period: December 2026 - March 2027.

• Applicants will receive answers: Ultimo March 2027.

• Fellowship begins: 1 September 2027.

About AIAS

As an 'Institute for Advanced Study,' AIAS brings researchers together across disciplines, seniority and nationality. AIAS offers fellowships for excellent researchers from all academic disciplines to pursue cutting-edge research projects for the benefit of society and humankind in optimal research conditions.

The daily encounter with colleagues from diverse research disciplines at AIAS provides fellows with fresh and different insights, methods and perspectives on their own research, leading to new and unexpected research questions and ideas.

Are you driven by designing robust software architecture and solving complex system-level challenges in high-performance, real-time environments? Do you want to build systems that turn raw sensor data into precise and real-time metrics that golfers and broadcasters rely on?

At Trackman, we combine radar technology, computer vision, and data intelligence to redefine how golf is played, practiced and experienced. From local golf clubs to live TV broadcasts, our products set the global standard for accuracy, performance, and innovation.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to play a central role in architecting and evolving the software systems behind Trackman Range and Golf Broadcast.

In this role, you will design and own key parts of our real-time data processing platform, ensuring it is scalable, maintainable, and performant under demanding conditions. You will work at the intersection of software engineering and applied algorithms, translating mathematical models and signal-processing concepts into robust, production-grade systems.

You will be responsible for system-level design decisions, improving software architecture, and driving engineering quality across the codebase. This includes diagnosing complex system behavior, addressing performance regressions, and ensuring high standards of reliability, testability, and maintainability.

Job requirements

The Ideal Candidate Has

• 
A master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field

• 
Strong expertise in C++ and Python, with a track record of building high-performance, production-grade systems

• 
Experience designing and owning scalable software architectures and real-time data processing pipelines

• 
Strong understanding of performance engineering, multi-threading, and system-level debugging (e.g., concurrency issues, performance regressions)

• 
Experience driving code quality, testing, CI/CD, and managing technical debt in production systems

• 
Experience with Linux-based systems for development, deployment, and debugging of distributed applications

• 
Experience with Docker for containerization and orchestration of those applications

• 
5+ years of relevant experience with ownership of critical systems or components

Other Valued Experience

• 
Radar technology, signal processing, numerical algorithms and sensor fusion

• 
Computer vision, tracking, and camera calibration

• 
Deep learning model implementation and optimization

• 
Real-time camera and video systems, including stream handling, data capture and encoding/decoding

• 
GPU acceleration and performance profiling

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE ACOUSTIC ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

Every SOUNDBOKS starts with a great idea - but turning it into a speaker that can survive a festival, run for hours, and sound incredible takes a lot of engineering. As the Acoustic Engineer, you'll be taking charge of the acoustic development that helps bring those products to life.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

Concept & Prototype Development

• 
You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• 
You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• 
You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• 
You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

Simulation & Validation

• 
You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• 
You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• 
You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

Driver Specification & Verification

• 
You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

•

Job Description

We are looking for a Business Consultant who is motivated by creating solutions that make a real difference for our many clients. You will have the opportunity to work across industries, applying your expertise to help some of Denmark’s most exciting companies develop and strengthen their business.

Responsibilities

At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on a culture built around high agility, low hierarchy, fast decision-making, and strong team spirit.

We develop solutions for a wide range of clients, from smaller private companies to large-scale public sector projects. Regardless of the project size, you as a Business Consultant will make a noticeable impact together with some of the industry’s most talented colleagues.

We are looking for a Business Consultant with a strong and well-documented interest in digitalisation to support initiatives related to user involvement, training, benefits realisation, process optimisation, and change management. Your work will be tied to our large-scale projects across both the public and private sectors.

As a Business Consultant, you will help ensure that Netcompany’s IT projects are successfully anchored within our clients’ organisations and business processes. You will also play a key role in making sure users have the right capabilities and readiness, so that both users and the organisation are fully prepared when new solutions go live.

The role is diverse and dynamic. Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Supporting clients with change management initiatives.

• Preparing user guides and training materials, as well as conducting user training sessions.

• Performing analyses and reporting on organisational change readiness.

• Mapping processes and facilitating workshops with clients.

• Defining benefits tracking models and preparing communication plans.

• Building strong domain knowledge by participating in and facilitating analysis work, testing, and refinement activities.

About you

You actively seek understanding by asking questions and encourage learning through curiosity and dialogue. Deadlines do not intimidate you and you are willing to go the extra mile when needed. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are either a recent graduate or have a few years of experience — ideally working at the intersection of IT, business, and organisation, for example as an IT project manager or consultant.

• Have an interest in IT and digitalisation.

• Hold a relevant master’s degree, such as Cand.merc., Cand.it., Cand.scient., or similar.

• Have strong written and verbal communication skills and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Have experience working professionally with PowerPoint and Excel.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.
